evals.name: memo-single-page
evals.prompt: convert "<path>/internal-memo.pdf" ke html, font dan layoutnya samain ya
evals.expected_output: One self-contained .html reproducing a single-page A4 memo: centred wordmark, heading block, underlined title, justified body, a numbered list, three signature blocks whose scanned signatures keep their transparency, a QR code, and a footer address line. Images inlined as data URIs. Font family and size measured from the source, not guessed.
evals.source_note: Use any 1-page A4 memo with a logo, scanned signatures stored with soft masks, and justified body text. The soft masks are the point: without compositing them the signatures render as grey boxes.
assertions: Deliverable outputs/final.html exists
Single self-contained file: no external image or asset references
Source artwork is embedded rather than dropped or faked in CSS
Print CSS pins the sheet: @page sized to the source with zero margin
Body font family is the source's own
Body font size matches the source (tolerance 0.3pt)
Printed page count equals the source PDF
Printed page size equals the source PDF (within 2pt)
Extracted text matches the source (similarity >= 0.98)
High-fidelity text match (similarity >= 0.995)
Box borders and rules land within 2mm of the source
Soft-masked artwork keeps its transparency

evals.name: quotation-multipage-tables
evals.prompt: tolong bikin versi HTML dari "<path>/quotation.pdf" - harus persis sama seperti PDF-nya, mau dikirim ke client
evals.expected_output: One self-contained .html of every page: full-bleed header and footer artwork, centred bilingual titles, key/value tables with hairline rules and the correct column split, page-number strings, coloured footer bar. Page breaks match the source.
evals.source_note: Use any 4-6 page document with full-bleed vector artwork, bilingual label/value tables, and a NON-EMBEDDED body font (check the emb column in `pdffonts`) - that last property is what exercises the trap where the reference render is itself a font substitution.
assertions: Deliverable outputs/final.html exists
Single self-contained file: no external image or asset references
Source artwork is embedded rather than dropped or faked in CSS
Print CSS pins the sheet: @page sized to the source with zero margin
Body font family is the source's own
Body font size matches the source (tolerance 0.3pt)
Printed page count equals the source PDF
Printed page size equals the source PDF (within 2pt)
Extracted text matches the source (similarity >= 0.98)
High-fidelity text match (similarity >= 0.995)
Box borders and rules land within 2mm of the source
Soft-masked artwork keeps its transparency

note: Eval inputs are intentionally not committed: they were real client and internal documents. Substitute your own PDFs matching each source_note.
